label: Spring 2027

baseball.placement_note: Tee Ball has its own eligibility dates. Check the Tee Ball options in Sports Connect for birthday eligibility. FUN-damentals players must be 4 by the start of the season.
baseball.practices: Practices generally start in March. Tee Ball practices begin after Opening Day.

divisions.name: FUN-damentals
divisions.description: A parent-and-player introduction to throwing, catching, hitting and running the bases.

divisions.name: Tee Ball Monday
divisions.description: Learn the basics by hitting from a tee. Practices are on Mondays, with games on Saturdays at 1:00 p.m.

overview.name: Tee Ball
overview.description: Learn the basics by hitting from a tee. Choose Monday or Tuesday practice when you register.

divisions.name: Tee Ball Tuesday
divisions.description: Learn the basics by hitting from a tee. Practices are on Tuesdays, with games on Saturdays at 10 a.m.

divisions.name: Coach Pitch
divisions.description: Hit pitches from a coach while learning field positions and game basics.

divisions.name: Instructional Kid Pitch
divisions.description: Make the transition to player pitching with an emphasis on instruction and skill development.

divisions.name: Minor Player Pitch
divisions.description: Build pitching, hitting and defensive skills in player-pitch games.

divisions.name: Major
divisions.description: Develop game strategy and teamwork in the Little League Major division.

divisions.name: Intermediate 50/70
divisions.description: Transition to a larger diamond with a 50-foot pitching distance and 70-foot basepaths.

divisions.name: Senior
divisions.description: Continue competitive full-diamond baseball for older players.

softball.placement_note: This cutoff applies to all softball divisions.
softball.practices: Practices generally start in March or early April.

divisions.name: Coach Pitch
divisions.description: Learn to hit coach-delivered pitches, run the bases and field as a team.

divisions.name: Minor Player Pitch
divisions.description: Build confidence in player-pitch games and develop pitching, hitting and defensive skills.

divisions.name: Major
divisions.description: Build on fastpitch fundamentals with more game strategy and team play.

divisions.name: Junior
divisions.description: Keep developing fastpitch skills and game strategy in the Junior division.

divisions.name: Senior
divisions.description: Continue competitive fastpitch softball in the league’s oldest division.

team_schedule: Many teams meet two to three times a week between practices and games. Minors Player Pitch and Majors generally play one weeknight game and one Saturday game. Instructional teams may also play twice a week.
possible_travel: Some teams may travel to play neighboring leagues in Philipstown, Wappingers Falls, Hyde Park or Red Hook.
